_from: docs/plans/stories/PLAN.md. Story paintings for clans: one 1536x864 scene a page, filed as art/story/<story id>-<page>.webp. The win stories keep their old paintings in art/season-monsters.

styles.a: Dark gritty painterly medieval fantasy game art, hand-painted oil texture, rich muted earthy colours with warm firelight glow, dramatic cinematic light, a storybook illustration, suitable for children aged 8 to 12, no blood, no gore, no romance, no writing, no letters, no numbers anywhere.

pictures.name: clans-opening-1
pictures.prompt: A wide green valley at golden sunset, many small proud villages with colourful clan banners on the hillsides, miners with lanterns at mine mouths, smoke curling from chimneys. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: clans-opening-2
pictures.prompt: An empty, quiet little timber village at the foot of grassy hills, doors shut, an old gate with no banner, weeds between the cobbles, soft grey morning mist. No people. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: clans-opening-3
pictures.prompt: Four young cartoon-proportioned heroes, a knight, an archer, a wizard and a dwarf miner, raising a blank colourful banner over a wooden village gate, cheerful and brave, seen from behind and the side. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: clans-opening-4
pictures.prompt: A deep underground mine with tunnels glowing with gold veins and blue gems, wooden supports, a mine cart, and big friendly-scary monster shadows deep in the dark tunnels. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: clans-opening-5
pictures.prompt: Six castles on six distant hilltops around a small village in a valley, each castle a different colour of banner, and far away a misty peak with a sleeping dragon shape. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: clans-opening-6
pictures.prompt: Night, a great dark mountain range under a purple sky, two huge glowing eyes opening inside a mountain, a tiny village with lit windows far below. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: clans-arrives-giant-1
pictures.prompt: A purple stormy sky over a little village on hills, lightning flashing, a stone church bell tower with its bell swinging, villagers looking up. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: clans-arrives-giant-2
pictures.prompt: High in stormy mountains, Grimmor the huge Storm Giant with grey stony skin, a wild white beard crackling with lightning, stretching and yawning, picking up a boulder as big as a house. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: clans-arrives-giant-3
pictures.prompt: Village wall at dusk, brave scouts on the wooden ramparts pointing at a distant giant silhouette in a storm, defenders running with shields and torches. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: clans-arrives-golem-1
pictures.prompt: Inside a cosy village tavern, cups rattling on tables, dust drifting down from the roof beams, villagers gripping the table, a shaking feeling. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: clans-arrives-golem-2
pictures.prompt: A whole rocky hillside standing up as Old Craghold the Stone Golem, mossy boulders for a body, two glowing amber eyes, rocks tumbling off, at dusk. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: clans-arrives-golem-3
pictures.prompt: Village wall at dusk, scouts on wooden ramparts pointing at a huge stone golem rolling down distant hills, defenders running with shields and torches. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: clans-arrives-troll-1
pictures.prompt: Snow falling over a little village in the middle of the day, a frozen stone well, chickens hiding under hay in a barn, villagers wrapped in cloaks. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: clans-arrives-troll-2
pictures.prompt: From a frozen northern wasteland comes Frostjaw the big blue Ice Troll with icicle tusks, sniffing the air and grinning a frosty grin, snow swirling. Funny-scary, not gory. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: clans-arrives-troll-3
pictures.prompt: Village wall in snowy dusk, scouts on wooden ramparts pointing at a distant ice troll stomping through snow, defenders running with shields and torches. Landscape, wide.
